auth.onboardingTitle: Set up Seatline for your organisation
auth.onboardingBody: Nobody from your organisation uses Seatline yet. Create its workspace — you’ll be its first admin, and colleagues who sign in later join automatically.
auth.noAccessBody: Your organisation uses Seatline, but you don’t have access. Ask one of its Seatline admins to give you a role.
auth.inactiveBody: Your account is marked as no longer with the organisation. If this is wrong, ask a Seatline admin.
auth.privacy: Seatline stores only your name, e-mail address, team and job title — in Switzerland.
auth.signInBodyEmail: Use your Microsoft 365 work account, or get a sign-in link by e-mail.
auth.linkBody: You opened your sign-in link. Continue to sign in on this device.
auth.checkBody: If {email} can use Seatline, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once, for 15 minutes.
auth.checkHint: Nothing there after a minute? Look in the spam folder, or ask for a new link.
auth.pickBody: {email} belongs to more than one workspace. Which one do you want to open?
auth.onboardingBodyEmail: Create your company’s workspace — you’ll be its first admin. Then add colleagues under People & access; they sign in with an e-mail link.
auth.useMicrosoftBody: Your company signs in to Seatline with Microsoft 365. Please use “Sign in with Microsoft”.

admin.title: People & access
admin.accessViewer: Everyone in the organisation can view the map
admin.accessInvited: Only people you give a role
admin.accessHint: Applies to people who join from now on. Change existing people below.
admin.notConnected: This workspace isn’t connected to Microsoft 365 (demo or local workspace).
admin.consentNeeded: Seatline needs permission to read your organisation’s directory. A Microsoft 365 admin approves this once.
admin.syncHint: Syncs every night. Only name, e-mail, department and job title are copied. People who leave lose their seat; their history stays.
admin.onlyAdmins: Only admins can open this page.

privacy.title: Data protection
privacy.retention: Keep seat history and the activity log for
privacy.retentionHint: Every night, seat history that ended before this and older activity entries are deleted, and people who left before this are anonymised. Current seats are never deleted.
privacy.requestsHint: Access and deletion requests: use the ⋯ menu next to a person to download everything Seatline stores about them, or to forget someone who left.
privacy.forgetBody: Their name, e-mail, department and job title are removed from Seatline for good — also from the activity log. Their seat history stays, as “Former employee”. This can’t be undone.

teams.hint: Teams group people on the map and in the statistics. They come from the department in Microsoft 365; to set or change one, use ⋯ → Set team.
teams.title: Team of {name}
teams.label: Team
teams.microsoftHint: Pick an existing team or type a new one. A team set here stays, even when Microsoft 365 says otherwise.
teams.manualHint: Pick an existing team or type a new one. Leave it empty for no team.

moves.title: Moves
moves.intro: Prepare seat changes as a plan, check them on the map, then apply them now or on a chosen day. Nothing changes until a plan is applied.
moves.onlyEditors: Only editors and admins can plan moves.

moves.backToDraftDone: The plan is a draft again
moves.scheduledHint: It will be applied automatically early in the morning of that day. To change it, move it back to draft (More).

moves.noMoves: No moves yet. Open the plan on the map and drag people to their new seats, or move a whole team at once.

moves.moveTeamHint: Puts everyone of a team on free seats of a floor, room by room so they sit together. People already on that floor stay where they are. You can change single moves afterwards.

moves.teamPartly: {placed} moves added — {unplaced} people didn’t fit (not enough free seats).
moves.scheduleHint: The moves happen automatically early in the morning of this day. To move today, use “Apply now”.
moves.applyTitle: Apply {count, plural, one {# move} other {# moves}} now?
moves.applyBody: Everyone moves to their planned seat right away. Each move is kept in the seat history and can be changed later like any other.

planMode.hint: Drag people onto seats to plan where they’ll sit. Nothing changes until the plan is applied.
planMode.readOnly: Preview of a plan that isn’t a draft — move it back to draft to change it.

billing.seatsHint: You pay for active seats on your floor plans (blocked seats are free), counted every night. Prices exclude VAT where applicable.

legal.imprintBody: Seatline is office seat management software for companies using Microsoft 365, hosted in Switzerland.
legal.disclaimer: We check this website carefully but cannot guarantee that all information is complete and up to date. Links to other websites are their owners’ responsibility.
legal.agree: By signing in, your organisation accepts the <terms>terms of service</terms>. See also our <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

site.metaTitle: Seatline: seating plans for companies on Microsoft 365
site.metaDescription: See who sits where, plan moves and keep the history. Sign in with Microsoft 365. Hosted in Switzerland. Free for 30 days.
site.heroBody: A seating plan for companies on Microsoft 365. Draw your floors, give people a desk and plan moves. Hosted in Switzerland.
site.ctaNote: No credit card. Sign in with your work account.
site.mapAlt: A Seatline floor map: free desks in green, taken in grey, reserved in yellow.
site.f1Body: Free, taken and reserved desks at a glance. Find anyone in seconds.
site.f2Body: Upload your architect’s DXF or PDF and get rooms and desks drawn for you.
site.f3Body: Move people by dragging them to a new desk. Every change can be undone.
site.f4Body: Prepare a team move and let it happen overnight on the day you pick.
site.f5Body: Who sat where and since when, kept as long as you decide.
site.f6Body: People and departments update every night. Leavers free their desk.
site.pricingBody: You only pay for desks in use.
site.a1: In Switzerland, in Microsoft Azure (Zurich). Payments go through Stripe.
site.a2: Yes. People sign in with their work account and Seatline reads names and departments from your directory.
site.a3: Every active desk on your plans. Blocked desks are free.
site.a4: An admin subscribes in a few clicks. If nobody does, the workspace becomes read-only. Nothing is deleted.
site.finalTitle: Try it with your own floors

planImport.title: Import an architect plan
planImport.intro: Seatline reads the plan and suggests rooms and desks. You check them before anything is saved.
planImport.kindDxf: DXF from CAD: best results — rooms, names, desks and the scale. (DWG: save as DXF first.)
planImport.kindPdf: PDF exported from CAD: rooms, names and desks; the scale if it says “1:100”.
planImport.kindImage: Scan or photo (PDF, PNG, JPG): the background, rooms, desks and printed room names.
planImport.existing: This floor already has {rooms} rooms and {seats} desks. They stay; imported ones are added.
planImport.replacesPlan: The imported plan replaces the current background image.
planImport.readingHint: This can take up to a minute.
planImport.reviewHint: Tap a room or desk to leave it out. Nothing is saved until you import.
planImport.scaleFound: Scale from the plan: 1 m = {px} px. Sizes on the map are in metres.
planImport.scaleMissing: The plan has no scale. Set it afterwards with the ruler tool.
planImport.done: Imported {rooms} rooms and {seats} desks. Undo removes them again.

warnings.units_guessed: The drawing has no units; Seatline guessed them from its size. Check the scale.
warnings.no_rooms: No rooms found. Draw them on the plan with the room tool.
warnings.no_seats: No desks found. Add them with the desk tool or “Desk row”.
warnings.scan: This is a scan: rooms, desks and names are read from the drawing. Please check them.
warnings.first_page_only: Only the first page of the PDF is used.

errors.plan_dwg: DWG files can’t be read directly. In your CAD program, save the plan as DXF and import that.
errors.plan_unsupported: This file type isn’t supported. Use DXF, PDF, PNG or JPG.
errors.plan_unreadable: The file couldn’t be read. Is it damaged or password-protected?
errors.plan_too_complex: The plan is too large to read. Try exporting just this floor.
errors.plan_too_large: The file is larger than 25 MB.
errors.plan_timeout: Reading the plan took too long. Try exporting just this floor.
errors.plan_engine_unreachable: The plan reader is starting. Please try again in a minute.
errors.failed: Reading the plan didn’t work. Please try another file.
